In this petition, petitioners have sought for the following relief:-
"WHEREFORE, the petitioners most respectfully prays that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash the proceedings in CC No.1188/2024 for the offence punishable under Section 498a r/w 34 of IPC on the file of 2nd Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Chikkamagaluru, in the interests of justice and equity."

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed two separate affidavit duly signed by the petitioners,
2nd respondent and the same is taken on record.

3. Petitioner Nos.1 to 6 - accused Nos.1 to 4, 6 and 7 and respondent No.2 are physically present before the Court and they admit the contents of the affidavits.
4. The affidavit filed by petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 4, 6 and 7, reads as under:-
"We, (1) Mohammed Umar S/o Late Dore, Aged about 28 years, R/at 2nd cross, Near Ummar masjed, Shanthi Nagar Uppalli, Indavara Post, Chikkamagaluru - 577101,

I have not suppressed the true facts..."

7. Petition stands disposed of accordingly in terms of the aforesaid affidavits.
